mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_browse_history (user_id, book_id, browse_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT h.*, b.book_name, b.category_id FROM t_browse_history h LEFT JOIN t_book b ON h.book_id = b.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.browse_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY h.browse_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
